title: City of San Diego Offers Resources to Individuals Experiencing Homelessness
description:
The City continues hosting outreach events to connect individuals experiencing homelessness with a variety of services and resources – including support for their furry companions!

Pets are an important part of many people’s lives, which is why we’re grateful to community partners Project Street Vet, Spay Neuter Action Program and A New Life Rescue for joining us in providing critical pet services. Last week’s event was held in the Midway District.

Through these outreach events, individuals experiencing homelessness have direct access to important resources for both them and their pets all in one place.

Thank you to our community partners for collaborating with the City of San Diego to provide these resources!
